reason: The coding description copied the abstract's opening sentence summarizing Knobe and Roedder's (2006) valuing study, whereas Gonnerman's (2008) own Study 1 (§3.1, published article copy) tests the analogous pattern for desire attributions with 44 participants (N = 25 and N = 19, no exclusions). For the critical two-group t-test in Study 1 (§3.1, published article copy), the paper reports p < 0.05, matching both the shipped coding (0.05 with '<' bound) and blind extraction.
